items.title: Measure ledger reader cost before proposing caching
items.context: Claude R1-03 is explicitly unmeasured. core/store.ts scans receipts and hashes prefixes when reading ledger-backed findings. items.title: Clarify the legacy RED selector without weakening its negative control
items.context: Claude R3-01: packages/main/tests/red/red-bfe8f-ledger-runtime-integrity.mjs:41-46,143-148 retains currentFails=true inside an explicitly labelled legacyPinnedNegativeControl carrier.
